rules.title: Boston fair housing protection for renters using rental assistance (source of income)
rules.requirement: In Boston, housing providers may not discriminate against applicants or tenants because they use rental assistance. Refusing to accept rental assistance, including Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers and veterans vouchers, counts as housing discrimination. Complaints can be filed with the Boston Fair Housing Commission, which investigates and tries to resolve them.
rules.key_value: Cannot refuse tenants because they use rental assistance (Section 8, disability or veterans vouchers)
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing in the City of Boston; the page states no unit-count or other coverage conditions.
rules.interaction: The Commission enforces local, state and federal fair housing laws. Discrimination outside Boston must be filed with the state.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance.
rules.penalty: Complaint investigated by the Boston Fair Housing Commission; if discrimination is found, the Commission tries to resolve the complaint.
